info.description: Extra JSON-LD schema markup for one page, matched by its URL path. Works for every kind of page: legacy pages, builder pages, blog posts and knowledge base articles.

path.description: The page's URL path, e.g. / for the homepage, /cloud-hosting, /blogs/my-post, /knowledge-base/my-article. Saved lowercase without a trailing slash or domain.

label.description: Readable page name, shown in this list only.
